summary: Iter44 — Regrow from Scraps + Cut Flowers feature: full backend + frontend acceptance verified. Backend pytest 11/11 PASS covering (a) GET /api/plants?language=en returns 31 regrow plants each with regrow{method,instructions,days_to_first_harvest,yield_summary,worth_it}, (b) 22 cut-flower plants each with cut_flower_data{vase_days,cut_at_stage,conditioning,cut_and_come_again,arrangement_role}, (c) tomato negative case (no flags, no sub-objects), (d) DE locale preserves both sub-objects on all 31 regrow + 22 cut-flower plants, (e) regression: 333 total plants + cherry-tomato still present. Frontend Playwright PASS on all acceptance scenarios: /plants special-row chips toggle correctly (333→31 regrow, 333→22 cut-flower, toggles OFF correctly); /plants/dahlia renders cut-flower section with '7 days' vase life + 'Warm water hold' conditioning + 'Focal' role + 'Cut when fully open' stage + honest 'seed' note, NO regrow section; /plants/basil renders regrow section with 'Root in water, transfer to soil' method, 5★ rating, days_to_first_harvest, plant-regrow-instructions testid (181 chars), Kid-friendly badge present, NO cut-flower section; /plants/tomato renders NEITHER section. /regrow-from-scraps: H1='Regrow from Scraps', all 4 method chips present, 31 default cards, 'Soil only' narrows to 2, click first card (basil) navigates to /plants/basil. /cut-flowers: H1='Cut Flowers', all 6 role chips, sort

issues:
Cosmetic only: the meta-line

inside each card uses data-testid='cut-card-vase-{id}' which collides under a prefix-match selector with the parent link's 'cut-card-{id}'. Visible UI is correct (22 cards), but the nested testid inflates ^= queries to 44. Consider renaming nested testid to e.g. cut-card-meta-{id} or vase-meta-{id} to avoid the prefix collision and align with how Plants.jsx uses plant-card-meta-{id} / plant-card-botanical-{id}.

action_items: (Cosmetic) Rename cut-card-vase-{id} → cut-card-meta-{id} in /app/frontend/src/pages/CutFlowers.jsx line 115 to avoid prefix-selector collision with parent cut-card-{id} link.

(Minor) /regrow-from-scraps?lang=de query string does NOT switch the i18n locale — the H1 stayed in English. The de.js translations exist and the task spec's OR condition is satisfied, but if URL-driven locale switching is expected as a user-facing affordance for sharing localized SEO landing pages, wire ?lang= into the i18n context on mount.
critical_code_review_comments:
CutFlowers.jsx line 115 — nested data-testid='cut-card-vase-{p.id}' on a

element collides with prefix-match queries against the parent . Recommend renaming to cut-card-meta-{p.id} for consistency with the equivalent Plants.jsx pattern.

PlantDetail.jsx RegrowSection/CutFlowerSection — conditional render uses `!isAi && plant.regrow` / `!isAi && plant.cut_flower_data`. Verified working: dahlia (curated, cf only) renders only cf section, basil (curated, regrow only) renders only regrow, tomato (curated, neither) renders neither. AI guides correctly excluded.

core.py apply_regrow_meta + apply_cut_flower_meta wired so non-EN payloads retain the rich sub-objects via dict(p) merge — verified on DE: 31/31 regrow and 22/22 cut-flower plants retain their sub-objects. This is the right pattern and means the new landing pages will work for any locale.

i18n de.js (and presumably the other 56 locales the translation script ran for) has regrow.title, cut.title, plants.special.regrow, plants.special.cut-flower as non-English strings — verified via grep.
Regression unaffected: total plant count still 333, calendar still loads, cherry-tomato curated guide still present.

Optional follow-up: Consider exposing a count badge on the special-row chips (e.g. 'Regrow from scraps (31)') so users know the size of the curated collection before clicking — currently they only learn it after the filter applies.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all acceptance scenarios — /plants chips, /plants/dahlia, /plants/basil, /plants/tomato, /regrow-from-scraps, /cut-flowers, i18n, calendar regression

test_credentials: Not required for this iteration (no auth-gated endpoints in scope). Admin token not exercised.
seed_data_creation: None — curated data is static via /app/backend/plants_regrow.py and /app/backend/plants_cut_flower.py.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter44 ships 'Regrow from Scraps' + 'Cut Flowers' frontend on top of already-wired backend curated data. Acceptance is fully green. Only two cosmetic notes: (1) nested cut-card-vase-{id} testid collides with parent under prefix queries — visible UI still correct; (2) ?lang=de URL query does not switch UI locale on landing pages — de.js translations exist so SEO-OK. Test file lives at /app/backend/tests/test_regrow_cutflower_iter44.py and can be re-run as a 4-second smoke whenever core.py or the curated data files change.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs detected. The two cosmetic notes (testid prefix collision on CutFlowers.jsx:115 and absence of URL-driven locale switching on /regrow-from-scraps?lang=de) are documented under action_items as low-priority cleanup.
